_comment: Content for /uses. Edit this file rather than the page component, because the AI half of this list turns over fast. Tags: free | paid | open-source | self-hosted | favourite.

groups.name: AI coding
groups.note: The part of this list that changes fastest. Treat anything here as current only as of the newest entry on the now page.

items.name: Claude Code
items.description: Agentic coding in the terminal. Main harness for anything touching a real repo.

items.name: OpenCode
items.description: CLI coding harness. What the autonomous ticket loop drives.

items.name: Cursor
items.description: Editor-native completion and inline edits for smaller, local changes.

items.name: Unity
items.description: The engine the day job is built on.

items.name: JetBrains Rider
items.description: C# IDE. Still the best debugger story for Unity.

groups.name: Version control
groups.note: Most of the handbook's version-control section is about making these two behave on a repo full of binary assets.

items.name: Git
items.description: With LFS, and with the large-repo tuning from the 2014 post still largely intact.

items.name: Git LFS
items.description: For art and other binary assets. Necessary, not sufficient.

items.name: GitHub Actions
items.description: CI, PR automation, and where the review bot runs.

items.name: Linear
items.description: Ticket queue. Also the input to the autonomous loop.

items.name: Cloudflare Pages
items.description: Where this site is built and served from.

items.description: Static build for the blog, the handbook and everything else.
